dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would you even do that?

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: I'm not as strong as him. I went there to wrestle, so of course I wanted to win, but he was better than me. I had no choice but to think outside the box.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: There we were, wrestling away, and I could see he was going to win. I was desperate.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Looking back, it's hard to comprehend what I was thinking. Maybe I just thought it would be funny.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Anyway, I just gave him a little tickle under the armpit, and in the excitement, he threw me right out of the ring!
